name: Ironforge Airfield
summary: Gnome flying machines and dwarven mountaineers keep watch at Ironforge Airfield, high above Dun Morogh. Its plateau overlooks jagged crags and the steep descent toward the Wetlands.

sections.title: A Hidden Redoubt in the Crags
sections.body: Above Dun Morogh's trails, gnome flying machines line open strips among the peaks. Dwarven stonework holds the ridgelines, where mountaineers watch the perimeter. Nearby, engineers tend the machines and inspect their engines in the cold.

sections.title: Frontier Skirmishes and Frozen Valleys
sections.body: Frostmane trolls dwell in caves near the airfield and harass the dwarven sentries. Across the frozen waters beneath the peaks, dwarven defenders and Stormpike patrols clash with troll raiders. So the outpost remains on guard.

faq.q: How do you get up to the airfield?
faq.answer: No roads, flights, or maintained tunnels link the valley to Ironforge or lower Dun Morogh. You must climb steep mountainsides on foot, following difficult ridgeline paths from Loch Modan or near Dun Morogh's passes.

faq.q: What is the purpose of this place?
faq.answer: The airfield tests and maintains flying machines and scouts the mountain borderlands between Dun Morogh, Loch Modan, and the Wetlands. Dwarven mountaineers and gnome engineers work there.

faq.q: Who is attacking the dwarven guards here?
aliases: who is fighting on the lake
faq.answer: Frostmane trolls from nearby caves attack the dwarven guards. The mountaineers clash with them over the frozen lake below the runway.

faq.q: Is the airfield tied to any official quests?
faq.answer: No standard assignment sends travelers to the airstrip. The remote plateau lies apart from the dwarven kingdom's main routes.

angles.text: As a tinker, you see gnomish flying machines assembled and kept in extreme cold.
As a dwarf, you know Ironforge's Mountaineers keep watch even in Khaz Modan's most inaccessible heights.
